name: Lone Wolf's Insignia
descriptionTemplate:
At the beginning of the battle, shuffle in 3 random "Symptoms". When playing "Symptoms," gain [Arg1] {STR}.
{With your help, no one from the Expedition Team survived, and you indifferently gained the greatest benefit for yourself. But was it all really worth it?}
lore: With your help, no one from the Expedition Team survived. You secured the greatest benefit for yourself, but was it truly worth it?
